# E0702: ambiguous address

The path names two declarations, so the address adds the hash of the one you mean, as `stilt show --json` gives it. Nothing was written.

- Rule: [`edits.refusals`](../../reference/19-tools.md#edits.refusals)
- Reported at: the second declaration that the address names.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `refusal` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0702_one_name_for_two_functions.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0702_one_name_for_two_functions.lt):

`E0702_one_name_for_two_functions.lt`:

```stilt fragment
fn total() -> i64 { 1 }

fn total() -> i64 { 1 }
```

`E0702_one_name_for_two_functions.edits`, beside it:

```text
main.total#55a0
fn total() -> i64 { 2 }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── AMBIGUOUS ADDRESS ────────── E0702_one_name_for_two_functions.lt:3:1  [E0702]

`main.total` names two functions:

  1 │ fn total() -> i64 { 1 }
    │ ─────────────────────── the first
  2 │ 
  3 │ fn total() -> i64 { 1 }
    │ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the second

The path names two declarations, so the address adds the hash of the one you
mean, as `stilt show --json` gives it. Nothing was written.
```
